claims.claim: That page reports the guideline establishes a near-blanket ban on using LLMs to generate or rewrite article content.
claims.quote: the use of LLMs to generate or rewrite article content is prohibited

claims.claim: That page states LLM outputs become worse when the questions are complicated or about obscure subjects.
claims.quote: outputs become worse when they are asked questions that are complicated

claims.claim: Min and colleagues human-evaluated the factual precision of people biographies generated by commercial language models and found ChatGPT reached only 58%.
claims.source: Sewon Min et al., 'FActScore: Fine-grained Atomic Evaluation of Factual Precision in Long Form Text Generation', arXiv:2305.14251

claims.claim: Their reported FActScores on people biographies are 42.5% for InstructGPT, 58.3% for ChatGPT and 71.5% for the retrieval-augmented PerplexityAI.
claims.source: Sewon Min et al., arXiv:2305.14251, Table 1
claims.quote: FACT S COREs of 42.5% and 58.3%, respectively.

claims.claim: They find factual precision falls as the subject person becomes rarer in the pretraining corpora, consistently across all the models tested.
claims.quote: Error rates are higher for rarer entities.

claims.feature: other: error accumulates through the record
claims.claim: They find factual precision is significantly worse in the later part of a generated biography than in its opening.
claims.quote: Error rates are higher for facts mentioned later
